transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, let's get into our transport-board huddle. We have four moves on today's internal support board: clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, a communications mast to the north relay point, a generator to the engineering yard, and routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Our available vehicles are the refrigerated van RV-2, the flatbed F-7, the 5-ton truck T-5, and the 2.5-ton truck T-2 — each can only cover one move today. I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load or vehicle-control requirements before I finalize the assignments.
